title: 第2016章 以一敌二优势在我第2015章 黑罗败出手
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
第2016章以一敌二，优势在我
黑罗仙界。
天穹中一片漆黑，顾安与两只妖兽分列东西，气机针锋相对，寸步不让。
方才一番试探，双方对彼此的实力都有所了解。
“一只主修洞天法的妖龙，已凝聚了二十四重真仙天，一只主修元仙法的银雕，已凝聚了二十五道真仙环。”
顾安心中默默盘算，“修为不低，在真仙后期中也不算弱手，更何况背景深厚，传承与宝物皆是不弱，看来得费一番手脚了。”
但他心中却没有丝毫不悦。
此时的他，也通过下方仍在激战的一众真仙初期，真仙中期的妖兽，差不多猜到了它们的来历。
一方应是黑罗仙界的妖兽，黑羊新死，还没来得及收拾，另一方则整整有九座仙舟，能组织起这等规模的船队，也只有诸界联军了！
“踏破铁鞋无觅处，得来全不费工夫！”
顾安喃喃轻声，眼中有兴奋在闪烁，“将你们全杀了，应能很是拖延一番那群孽畜破开羽茧的速度。”
一念至此，杀意暴涨，猩红之色滚滚四散，染红天穹。
法体一阵激鸣，筋如狂蟒肉似虬龙，血气冲天，煞光四射，万煞血狱真体一经施展，汹涌磅礴的威压便席卷整个黑罗仙界。
这可是他已经修炼到七阶极品的神通！
“不好！”
赤元真仙龙瞳猛地一缩，不禁咬牙骂道，“这是猩红仙界的传承，是万煞血狱真体，但此獠怎么会有，还修炼到了这种程度……莫不是猩红仙界在暗中捣鬼？”
“按理来说，没道理的！”
银雕真仙同样面色难看，催动层层灵罩护住周身，“但也说不好那群孽畜抽风，不过现在不是计较这个的时候，先将其斩了，咱们回去再禀告此事！”
嗡——
两大真仙后期妖兽齐齐出手，赤元真仙头顶的赤旗翻卷，点点火星密织成线，顺着灵气蔓延，转瞬间烧成燎原大火，银雕真仙则取出一枚银梭，流线形的梭身破空而去，分开道道银色风流，锋芒毕露！

“死来！”
顾安眼中寒意凛冽，煞气与血光汹涌而出，自手臂流向周天星辰戟，瞬间染成黑红两色，好似烈焰一般熊熊燃烧。
长戟横天，朝着那银梭当头劈下。
神光铺地，与蔓延来的赤火撞在一起。
轰轰——
银梭飞退，长戟荡回，扩散开来的造化神光与赤火相互僵持片刻，双双湮灭。
“敕！”
一击不成，一击又起。
顾安轻吟一声，攻势如狂风暴雨连绵，但见九渊归墟镜缓缓升起，镜面寒光闪烁，酝酿已久的太玄造化神光悍然射出。
不止一道！
整整九道太玄造化神光，威压强横，将整个黑罗仙界挤地好似筛子一般，到处都是裂隙，更隐隐与那【造化劫】中的万千光景呼应，威势更胜一筹。
见状，两妖不敢大意。
赤元真仙洞天轮转，催起真仙妙景【九龙炎】，灵光显化，九道栩栩如生的赤龙骤然睁眼，腾龙九天，带起无尽烈焰，汇聚到赤元真仙口中，化为一道烈焰光柱射去。
银雕真仙也不甘示弱，【天银痕】凝聚而出，好似一道裂隙，横亘在天穹之上，微微放着银光，使得银雕真仙双翼间银光更盛。

content_en:
Chapter 2016: One against two, the advantage is mine
Black Luo Immortal World.
The sky was pitch black, and Gu An and the two demonic beasts lined up east and west, facing each other tit for tat, refusing to give in an inch.
After some testing, both sides knew each other's strength.
"A demon dragon who majors in Cave Heaven Technique has condensed twenty-four levels of true immortal heaven, and a silver eagle who majors in Yuan Xian Technique has condensed twenty-five layers of true immortal heaven."
Gu An silently calculated in his mind, "The cultivation level is not low, and he is not weak in the late stage of True Immortal. What's more, he has a deep background, and the inheritance and treasures are not weak. It seems that it will take a lot of effort."
But there was no dissatisfaction in his heart.
At this time, he also almost guessed their origins through the monster beasts in the early stage of True Immortal and the middle stage of True Immortal that were still fighting fiercely below.
One side should be the demonic beasts from the Black Luo Immortal Realm. Black Sheep has just died and has not had time to deal with it. The other side has nine immortal boats. Only the coalition of all realms can organize a fleet of this size!
“You can’t find anything even after wearing iron shoes, but it takes no effort to get there!”
Gu An murmured softly, excitement flashing in his eyes, "Killing all of you should be able to delay the speed of those evil beasts breaking out of their cocoons."
As soon as he thought of this, his murderous intention surged, and the scarlet color rolled out in all directions, dyeing the sky red.
The legal body roared with excitement, its muscles were like wild pythons and its flesh was like a horned dragon, its blood energy was soaring to the sky, and evil light was shooting out. Once the Ten Thousand Evils Blood Prison True Body was activated, the majestic pressure swept across the entire Black Luo Immortal World.
This is a magical power that he has cultivated to the seventh level!
"Not good!"
Chi Yuan's True Immortal Dragon Eyes suddenly shrank, and he couldn't help but gritted his teeth and cursed, "This is the inheritance of the Scarlet Immortal Realm, and it is the true body of the Ten Thousand Evils Blood Prison, but how can this beast exist and cultivate to this level... Could it be that the Scarlet Immortal Realm is secretly causing trouble?"
"Logically speaking, it doesn't make sense!"
The Silver Eagle True Immortal also had an ugly look on his face, and activated the layers of spiritual shields to protect his whole body, "But I can't say that those evil beasts are going to have a seizure, but now is not the time to worry about it. Let's kill them first, and let's go back and report this matter!"
Buzz——
The two late stage demon beasts of the True Immortal took action together. The red flag above True Immortal Chi Yuan's head rolled up. Dots of sparks were densely woven into threads. They spread along the aura and burned into a prairie fire in an instant. The Silver Eagle Immortal took out a silver shuttle. Its streamlined shuttle body broke through the air and separated into silver winds, revealing its sharp edge!
"Come die!"
Gu An's eyes were filled with coldness, evil energy and bloody light surged out, flowing from his arm to the Zhoutian Star Halberd, instantly dyed black and red, burning like a raging flame.
The halberd flew across the sky and struck the silver shuttle head-on.
Divine light spread across the ground, colliding with the spreading red fire.
Boom boom——
The silver shuttle flew back, the halberd reverberated, and the spreading divine light of creation and the red fire were in a stalemate with each other for a moment, and both were annihilated.
"Edict!"
One blow fails, another blow strikes.
Gu An groaned softly, and the offensive continued like a violent storm, but he saw the Jiuyuan Guixu Mirror rising slowly, the mirror's cold light flickering, and the Taixuan Creation Divine Light that had been brewing for a long time shot out boldly.
More than one!
The entire nine rays of Taixuan's Divine Light of Creation were so overwhelming that they squeezed the entire Black Luo Immortal Realm like a sieve. There were cracks everywhere, and they faintly echoed the thousands of scenes in the [Calamity of Creation] and were even more powerful.
Seeing this, the two demons did not dare to be careless.
The heavenly wheel of Chi Yuan True Immortal Cave arouses the wonderful scene of the True Immortal [Nine Dragon Flames], and the spiritual light manifests. Nine lifelike red dragons suddenly open their eyes, soaring into the sky, bringing endless flames, which converge into the mouth of Chi Yuan True Immortal, and turn into a pillar of blazing flames and shoot out.
Not to be outdone, the Silver Eagle True Immortal condensed out the [Silver Traces in the Sky], like a crack across the sky, with a faint silver light, making the silver light between the Silver Eagle True Immortal's wings even brighter.
